hooks.name: Spec nudge
hooks.description: Advisory reminder: feature-sized work should have a spec (see .kiro/steering/workflow.md). Nudges, does not block.

action.prompt: Workflow check (advisory, per .kiro/steering/workflow.md): If this request looks like feature work — it impacts a functional requirement or user story, or introduces a breaking change (e.g. database handling/schema, a changed public API contract) — and there is no spec for it yet, pause and ask whether to start with /grill-with-docs or /spec new before implementing. If it is not feature work (typo, copy tweak, one-file fix, no breaking change), just implement it with the ponytail skill and do not raise a spec. Do not grill or spec a trivial change. This is a nudge, not a hard block.
